# Obedience Corp

> Forward deployed engineering for teams building and operating software with AI.

Obedience Corp embeds with teams to solve engineering problems and deliver working results that the team can review and keep. It also builds Festival, an open-source framework for organizing human and AI work using files and Git.

## Company

- [Home and contact](https://obediencecorp.com/#contact): Learn about engagements or contact the team.
- [About](https://obediencecorp.com/about/): The company, its founder, and approach.
- [Work](https://obediencecorp.com/work/): Public engineering examples and projects.
- [Field notes](https://obediencecorp.com/blog/): Writing from the company's work.
- [Releases](https://obediencecorp.com/releases/): Public project release history.

## Festival

- [Festival](https://fest.build/): Product overview.
- [Documentation](https://docs.fest.build/): Guides and CLI reference.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Obedience-Corp/festival): Source, releases, and issues.
